promotion_decision.reason: W1 failed the predeclared W1-vs-W0 gate. W0 was only a matched continuation control and had no predeclared source-promotion gate; descriptively it reduced mean best progress from 9.482237 m to 7.387683 m while changing endpoint airborne by only -0.002639 and mean support by only +0.004028.

post_training_substep_screen.interpretation: Descriptive only because a full-substep threshold was not predeclared in this frozen run. It does not rescue W1 promotion.

measurement_boundaries.airborne: The legacy endpoint airborne metric is phase-sensitive; full-interval five-substep zero-foot contact is reported separately.
measurement_boundaries.slip: The field corrected_sustained_slip_step_fraction is sampled at control-step endpoints and is therefore interpreted as endpoint-sampled sustained slip; tangential speed was not recorded at every physics substep.
measurement_boundaries.terrain_relative_termination: The current wrapper termination still uses world-frame quaternion tilt, while evaluation reports terrain-normal-relative tilt. At 8 degrees with an 80-degree threshold this is unlikely to reverse this run, but it must be corrected before steeper formal tests.

next_diagnostic: Read-only speed ablation plus native-plane versus numerical-flat-heightfield comparator; no further reward scan before that result.
